prose: Basis: Techmeme's feed summary of a Financial Times article; the FT source fetch failed. An FT survey of 94 economists finds 54% expect AI's economic gains to spread across the G20 over the next decade rather than concentrating in the US and China. A substantial minority - 32 respondents - see African countries falling behind, tempering the diffusion optimism with a warning about where the gains may not reach.
highlights: FT survey of 94 economists: 54% expect AI gains to spread across the G20 within a decade
Consensus is against a US-China-only concentration of benefits
32 of 94 economists see African countries falling behind
